clog.text: People keep to their own circles. No one yet speaks for the whole colony.
Elmo-83 spoke of a dome at the meeting in the habitat: a roof of sky, and streets without suits.
The council has agreed to build a dome. Elmo-83 spoke for it first, and tonight, in the green room, Jezero promised to build it together, because its bolder hearts would not wait.
Mero-90 still says not yet, but will build with the rest.
The council still meets most evenings. With the dome agreed, the talk is of smaller things.
